# Requirement To Architecture

Use this skill when moving from approved requirements to architecture/design.

## Procedure

1. Verify requirement baseline and record its version.
2. Capture architecture inputs, tech stack, principles, constraints, and decisions.
3. Map requirement IDs to architecture sections and ADRs.
4. Create architecture artifacts.
5. Create requirement-back questions for new scope or ambiguous behavior discovered during design.

**Why?** Architecture should trace to requirements and expose gaps instead of hiding them.
